---
name: Feature request
description: Suggest a new feature or improvement for the MSS-Login ComfyUI node
title: "[Feature] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: []
---

## Problem or motivation

What problem would this solve, or what workflow would it improve? (e.g. "As a Power user I want …" or "Currently there is no way to …")

## Proposed solution

A clear description of the feature or change you’d like.

## Area

- [ ] Auth (login, MFA, API tokens, sessions)
- [ ] RBAC / permissions / roles
- [ ] UI enforcement / settings panel
- [ ] User environment / per-user folders
- [ ] IP filtering
- [ ] NSFW Guard / gallery
- [ ] Extension Tabs API / integration
- [ ] Performance or security
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (please explain below)

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches or workarounds you’ve thought about.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, or references to similar behavior in other tools (without copying proprietary design).

## Impact to the project

How will this impact the project? Will it help it, slow it down, or make it more unique?

## Additional required dependencies

Will this new feature/idea require additional dependencies, and if so, which one(s)?
